headline: President Obama changed an earlier executive order, Executive Order 12137, which deals with how the Peace Corps is run.
what_it_does: This order makes changes to Executive Order 12137, a 1979 order that sets out rules for how the Peace Corps operates. No summary was provided, so the specific changes cannot be described here.
when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 8, 2016; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
